regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing, six-of-twenty-two eligible rotation with AI Compute & Optics as the leader by score (1.47) and Gold Miners as the challenger (0.812), but the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on China A-shares history (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape), so trend discipline has no validated drawdown edge here and scores are display-only. Track record shows hit_rate 0.556 but directional accuracy 0.361, meaning past high-conviction directional leans often missed — default to low conviction. Macro narrative is entirely unscheduled/surprise-driven (1.0 share), so no followable regime signal.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners (currently challenger, score 0.812, hurst_tag=trend) becomes the confirmed leader over AI Compute & Optics. The observable that would retire this watch is Gold Miners' score exceeding AI Compute & Optics' score in two consecutive daily detector prints. Note: Gold Miners is not scorable (no ETF proxy), so this is early-hypothesis only.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors (512760.SS) is the highest-ranked eligible theme with trend-health (hurst_tag=trend) and the strongest durability_bar (0.58) among eligible names, and it is not crowded (crowding_z=0.07). Unlike AI Compute & Optics, which shares the same 515000.SS proxy as Consumer Electronics and has a lower durability_bar (0.52), Semis carries steady breadth (0.364) with clean trend character. This is a lean on trend continuation, not on the rank itself.
theses.dissent: Semiconductors in China are structurally hostage to US export-control headlines and the tape mean-reverts (backtest verdict: gate did not hold), so trend continuation is the least reliable assumption on this benchmark.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal (515220.SS) is eligible but carries hurst_tag=mean-revert — the worst regime tag on a mean-reverting China tape where even the trend gate failed. Its score (0.54) is only mid-table and breadth (0.5) is unremarkable. Given gate_helps=false, mean-revert is a warning, not a buy setup.
theses.dissent: Coal could benefit from a sudden energy/geopolitics headline given the 100% unscheduled macro flow, and mean-revert in score terms could still be a short-term bounce.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
